transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

I guess… my eating has been off for a while. Months, really. Some days I barely have toast and coffee, and then other days I’m buying sweets at the bakery aisle even though I don’t really want them. It just feels… not normal for me.
When you find yourself buying sweets, even when you don’t really want them, does it feel like you can’t stop yourself once you start?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say I can’t stop. It’s more like I just sort of do it, and then I don’t feel much better after.
Do you ever feel like you eat a large amount of food in a short period, like you're losing control during those episodes?
Not really… I mean, I buy things and eat some, but I don’t think it’s a huge amount all at once. I don’t feel out of control like that.
When you're eating, even if it's not a huge amount, do you ever feel like you can't stop eating or control what or how much you're eating?
I… I don’t think so. I mean, I can stop if I need to. It’s more just… I eat without thinking much, sometimes.
Do you feel upset, ashamed, or distressed about your eating habits or the times when you eat in a way that doesn’t feel normal to you?

Yeah… I guess it bothers me. It’s not like I’m ashamed exactly, but my eating’s been… off for months. Some days it’s just toast and coffee, and then other days I’m standing there buying sweets I don’t even really want. It feels wrong, I guess.
Do you ever make yourself vomit or do anything else to try to prevent gaining weight after eating those sweets or on days when you feel like you've eaten more than you intended?
No… I don’t make myself sick or anything like that. I don’t really do anything after.

When you're eating those sweets or on days when your eating feels off, do you feel like you can't control yourself or that it's happening automatically, even if you could stop if you really wanted to?

I guess… it can feel a bit automatic, yeah. Not like I’m completely out of control, but my eating’s been all turned around for months. Some days I barely pick at toast and coffee, and then other days I’m in the bakery aisle buying sweets I don’t even really want.
Do you find yourself eating those sweets or eating more than you plan when you’re feeling stressed, sad, or upset?

Sometimes, I guess. I don’t always know if it’s because I’m upset… it’s just been all turned around for months. Some days it’s only toast and coffee, and then other days I’m in the bakery aisle buying sweets I don’t even really enjoy.
Do you ever eat sweets or find yourself eating in a way that feels out of control in private because you're embarrassed about it?

I don’t know… maybe a little. I don’t really like anyone seeing it. It’s just that my eating’s been all over the place for months—some days barely toast and coffee, and other days I’m standing there buying sweets I don’t even want.
Do you ever find yourself eating much more rapidly than usual during those times when your eating feels off?

I’m not sure about rapidly. It’s more that my eating’s been all turned around for months… some days I’m barely having toast and coffee, and then other days I’m just there buying sweets I don’t even really enjoy.
Do you usually eat sweets or eat in that off way when you're alone, or do you feel okay doing it in front of others?

Mostly alone, I think. I don’t really like making a thing of it. It’s just… my eating’s been off for months—some days it’s barely toast and coffee, and other days I’m buying sweets I don’t even enjoy.
Do you find yourself hiding or trying to keep secret the amount or type of food you eat during those times when your eating feels off?

I don’t know if I’d call it hiding exactly. I just… don’t really want people seeing it. My eating’s been so off for months—some days it’s just toast and coffee, and then other days I’m buying sweets in the bakery aisle that I don’t even enjoy.
Can you describe what typically goes through your mind before you find yourself eating sweets or eating in a way that feels off to you?

I don’t know… there isn’t always much going through my mind. It’s just that my eating has been all turned around for months. Some days I’m only picking at toast and coffee, and other days I end up in the bakery aisle buying sweets I don’t even really want.
Can you tell me if, during those times when your eating feels off, you experience a clear sense that you can't control your eating or that you're not in charge of what or how much you're eating?

I don’t know if it’s like I can’t control it exactly. It’s more… my eating’s just been all turned around. Some days I barely have toast and coffee, and then other days I’m standing there buying sweets I don’t even really want.

Do you ever find yourself eating even when you're not really hungry, like you're eating just because it's a certain time of day or because you're feeling something, even if you don't actually want food?

Yeah… sometimes. It’s not always because I’m hungry. My eating’s just been off for months—some days it’s barely toast and coffee, and other days I’m in the bakery aisle buying sweets I don’t even really enjoy.
Can you tell me if your eating tends to be connected to how you're feeling emotionally, like when you're stressed, sad, or upset?
Maybe… I’m not sure. I just know my eating’s been all turned around for months. Some days I only pick at toast and coffee, and other days I’m buying sweets I don’t even really want.
Can you tell me if you often find yourself eating even when you're not physically hungry, like it's not about needing food but more about something else?

I guess… sometimes it doesn’t feel like real hunger. Like I said, my eating’s just been turned around for months. Some days I barely pick at toast and coffee, and then other days I’m in the bakery aisle buying sweets I don’t even really enjoy.
Can you tell me if your eating tends to be connected to how you're feeling emotionally, like when you're stressed, sad, or upset?

I don’t know if it’s exactly tied to feelings. I just know my eating’s been all over the place for months… some days it’s barely toast and coffee, and other days I’m buying sweets in the bakery aisle that I don’t even really want.
Can you tell me if you ever have episodes where you eat a lot in a short amount of time, even if you don’t feel like you can’t control it, but you still feel upset about it afterward?

I don’t know if I’d call it a lot all at once. It’s more… my eating’s been off for months. Some days I just pick at toast and coffee, and other days I end up buying sweets in the bakery aisle that I don’t even really want.

Can you tell me if these times when you end up buying sweets or eating in a way that feels off happen more often when you’re feeling down, stressed, or upset, or do they seem to happen without any clear reason?

I’m not really sure there’s a clear reason. It’s just been turned around for months… some days I barely eat, just toast and coffee, and then other days I’m standing there buying sweets I don’t even really enjoy.
